python.build: A relate-db wheel that maturin built from surfaces/relate-python at upstream 6a0c391, installed in a venv with the pinned frameworks.

crewai.build: The same relate-db wheel (maturin, surfaces/relate-python at upstream 6a0c391), installed in a second venv with crewai, whose pins would hold the main venv's frameworks back.

js.build: A copy of clients/javascript at upstream 6a0c391 with koffi, loading librelate_ffi built from upstream 6a0c391 (cargo build -p relate-ffi --release), with the pinned frameworks beside it.

rust.build: The relate crate from an export of upstream ac441ec, as a path dependency of a template project carrying that commit's Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml.

java.build: A copy of clients/java at upstream 6a0c391 packaged with Maven 3.10.0 (relate-0.1.0.jar, with JNA 5.14.0 and Jackson databind 2.17.2 on the classpath), loading librelate_ffi built from upstream 6a0c391.

go.build: clients/go from an export of upstream ac441ec (the same files as at 6a0c391), built with cgo against relate.h and librelate_ffi built from upstream 6a0c391.

swift.build: A copy of Package.swift and clients/swift at upstream 6a0c391, with an XCFramework made from librelate_ffi built from upstream 6a0c391.

c.build: relate.h and librelate_ffi built from upstream 6a0c391 (cargo build -p relate-ffi --release).
